exposure: Refugee status (Eritrean and Sudanese refugees vs. native Israeli parturients)
cohort: 254 Eritrean and Sudanese refugees and a control group of native Israeli parturients who delivered between May 2010 and April 2011
finding: Refugees experienced more adverse perinatal outcomes, including premature deliveries, cesarean sections, and intrauterine fetal deaths, compared to native Israeli parturients.
mod_finding: Refugees required significantly more urgent cesarean sections (97%) compared to native Israeli parturients (53%).
